panels.title: Email attempt outcomes
panels.description: Procedure: Mailer.Send v1. Rate per second over the selected window, scoped to one scrape instance. accepted means SMTP accepted, not inbox delivery. unknown can have been accepted: do not blindly retry. Missing/stale targets show no data, not zero. Exact evidence is the private per-receipt protobuf file; counters reset at restart and are not a ledger. No failure-rate baseline is calibrated.

panels.title: Email attempt duration p95
panels.description: Procedure: Mailer.Send v1. Histogram estimate in seconds by delivery outcome, scoped to one scrape instance and rate window; includes provenance, rendering, receipt persistence and transport. No samples or an unavailable exporter is Unknown, never a measured zero. This is not operator inbox latency. No latency SLO is calibrated.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, outcome) (rate(csf_email_send_duration_seconds_bucket{instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on() (max(up{instance="$instance"}) == 1)
